reference: User supplied black-moss pixel-art creature sheet

prompts.encoberto: Production game sprite sheet, reference image defines eerie granular pixel-art texture and blue/violet corrupted moss flecks. Make a tall stooped humanoid with very long hanging arms, narrow body, head completely buried under a hanging black moss hood. Entire creature covered in BLACK MOSS and dark wet hanging fibers, no visible skin or clothing, face obscured with tiny dull violet eye pinpoints. Silhouette is nearly black charcoal, readable muted blue-green edge pixels, sparse deep cobalt and violet glitch specks embedded in moss, not bright neon armor. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows grid on transparent 1024x1024 square. Four animation frames across each row forming a complete slow walking cycle alternating limbs, slight moss sway. Rows: BACK facing north, RIGHT profile east, FRONT facing south, LEFT profile west. Fixed direction within row, no turning between frames. Match identical character size, thick silhouette and consistent ground anchor in each cell. Each creature full body centered x128 with feet ground y224 of its 256px cell, top around y44. Pixel art with crisp chunky pixels, limited palette, no smooth painted art. Separate clear transparent cells, no background, no ground, no grid, no labels, no text or cast shadows. This sheet is for one creature only, all sixteen sprites same design.
